_doc: Registry shown in the About panel. statusKey names a source in data/health.json (scheduled) or a live source tracked in the browser; entries without one are bundled or curated.

sources.name: World Bank WDI
sources.provides: GDP growth, inflation, official birr rate, reserves, external debt, population, remittances, FDI; neighbour comparison
sources.cadence: Daily job; the data itself is annual and lags 1-2 years

sources.name: IMF World Economic Outlook
sources.provides: Alternative GDP growth and inflation values shown in detail cards (never projections)
sources.cadence: Weekly job (Mondays)

sources.name: World Bank International Debt Statistics
sources.provides: External debt by creditor type and named creditor, debt ratios
sources.cadence: Daily job; annual data

sources.name: World Bank (all countries)
sources.provides: GDP, population and growth for every country in the relations panel
sources.cadence: Daily job; annual data

sources.name: World Bank Pink Sheet
sources.provides: Coffee, gold and crude oil monthly prices
sources.cadence: Daily job; the source updates monthly

sources.name: open.er-api.com
sources.provides: Daily market birr/USD rate
sources.cadence: Daily job

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.provides: Current weather and 7-day forecast for 8 cities
sources.cadence: Live, every 15 minutes, in your browser

sources.name: USGS Earthquakes
sources.provides: Earthquakes (M2.5+) in the Horn of Africa and Rift
sources.cadence: Live, every 10 minutes, in your browser

sources.name: IMF PortWatch
sources.provides: Daily ship transits through Bab el-Mandeb and Suez
sources.cadence: Daily job

sources.name: GDELT
sources.provides: News headlines about Ethiopia's economy and infrastructure
sources.cadence: Daily job; rate-limited, so often unavailable

sources.name: Ethiopian outlet RSS feeds
sources.provides: Headlines and links from Capital Ethiopia, The Reporter and Addis Fortune (topic-filtered)
sources.cadence: Daily job

sources.name: UN Comtrade
sources.provides: Trade by partner and commodity; bilateral trade in country profiles
sources.cadence: Daily job; data lags months to years

sources.name: HDX (HAPI)
sources.provides: People in need, food insecurity (IPC), staple food prices
sources.cadence: Daily job; many series update monthly or less

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.provides: Country boundaries, lakes and disputed areas for the map
sources.cadence: Static, bundled with the site

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (HOT exports on HDX)
sources.provides: Detailed map layers: rivers and tributaries, lakes, roads, railways, towns, facilities (health, schools, banks, fuel, markets) and city street networks
sources.cadence: Static snapshot built from the HOT export of November 2026; rebuilt by hand when refreshed
sources.access: Open data, ODbL 1.0 (© OpenStreetMap contributors); volunteer-mapped, so coverage is uneven

sources.name: Curated records
sources.provides: Infrastructure projects, relations profiles, bloc membership, IMF-programme and event timelines
sources.cadence: Hand-maintained, reviewed monthly; each record carries a last-verified date and source links

sources.name: World Bank RSDP study data
sources.provides: Road upgrades by RSDP phase and road surface type, 1996–2016 (road data from the Ethiopian Roads Authority)
sources.cadence: Static historical dataset; curated
sources.access: Public GitHub repository; no data licence stated

sources.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather (ERA5)
sources.provides: Monthly rainfall and temperature against the 1991–2020 normal for 8 cities
sources.cadence: Daily job; reanalysis lags about a week
sources.access: Free, no key; reanalysis grid, not station data

sources.name: Ethiopian News Agency (headlines)
sources.provides: Headline titles and links from the English homepage; no article text
sources.cadence: Daily job
sources.access: Public page (no RSS feed exists); robots.txt allows it; breaks if the page layout changes

sources.name: ACLED via HDX HAPI
sources.provides: Monthly conflict events and reported fatalities by zone and event type
sources.cadence: Daily job; source updates about monthly, recent months revised
sources.access: Free, no key (generic usage tag); reported events, under-counts poorly reported areas

sources.name: OCHA COD-AB Ethiopia boundaries
sources.provides: Region and zone boundaries for the risk layers
sources.cadence: Static; version 2025

sources.name: Rainfall anomaly (ERA5)
sources.provides: 90-day regional rainfall as a percent of the 1991–2020 normal
sources.cadence: Daily job; reanalysis lags about a week
sources.access: Free, no key; reanalysis at one point per region

sources.name: IMF WEO projections
sources.provides: IMF estimates and projections of Ethiopia's GDP growth and inflation
sources.cadence: Daily job; IMF revises each April and October
sources.access: Free, no key; official IMF SDMX API

sources.name: Conflict outlook (our model)
sources.provides: 3-month statistical outlook of conflict events, published only if it beats a baseline in backtest
sources.cadence: Daily job
sources.access: Computed here from ACLED counts; labelled model output

sources.name: Radio Browser directory
sources.provides: Ethiopian radio stations and their stream addresses
sources.cadence: Daily job; directory health-checks streams
sources.access: Free, no key; streams play from each station's own host

sources.name: Ethiopian Securities Exchange
sources.provides: Listed companies (name, symbol, sector, listing date); trading hours and holiday calendar. No prices.
sources.cadence: Company list: daily job. Hours and holidays: curated from ESX's page, last verified 2026-11-15
sources.access: Public pages; robots.txt allows it; breaks if the table layout changes
